findings.title: Regression test doesn't verify send() was actually refused
findings.claim: The catch block for rpc::closed_error has no matching failure path, so the test would pass even if the frame were accepted and didn't reach put() before release_close was set; it only detects the bug indirectly via put_after_close after 10 yield() calls.

findings.title: Only client-side stream connection is covered by the test
findings.claim: The server side has the same send_empty_frame hook and runs the same stream_close(), but hook_capturing_compressor_factory only records the client's hook, so the server path isn't tested.

findings.title: Test compressor implementation is needlessly odd/unclear
findings.claim: In hook_capturing_compressor_factory::compressor::compress, the data.size ? std::move(data) : snd_buf(...) substitution is unexplained, the const_cast in negotiate() exists only to record the hook, and the is_server parameter is unused.

findings.title: PR description contains a 'Generated with Claude Code' attribution line
findings.claim: The PR description carries a 'Generated with Claude Code' line, which should be removed per the user's global instructions against such attribution.
